title: Table
description:
A table shows the rows as they are: every column (or `column_list`), one row per result
row, long cells wrapping inside their column. See `:help dbdash-charts` and
`:help dbdash-css`.

args.name: team
args.description: Shown in the first panel's query

query.sql:
SELECT datetime('now', 'localtime') AS current_time,
       abs(random() % 100) AS load,
       abs(random() % 1000) AS sales,
       CASE abs(random() % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'Active' WHEN 1 THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS status,
       {{ args.team | sql_quote }} AS team

show.title: column_list: alias, width, thresholds
show.description:
`column_list` picks the columns in order: `alias` renames the header, `width` fixes
the width, `thresholds` give a column's cells a class by value (>= 50 `warning`,
>= 90 `danger`). The query reads the argument `team` (shown above the table by
`args_show`); `countdown { display: block }` shows the time to the next refresh.

query.sql:
SELECT 'disk ' || n AS volume, abs(random() % 100) AS free_pct
FROM (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4)

show.title: thresholds_below: lower is worse
show.description:
`thresholds_below: true` turns the steps around: a value at or below a step gets
its class (free space under 30% `warning`, under 10% `danger`).

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 9)
SELECT 'job-' || i AS job, abs(random() % 500) AS ms FROM n

show.title: sort, table { line-clamp }
show.description:
`sort` orders the rows here, whatever the query did (DataTables `order`):
`{ column, order: asc | desc }`, NULLs last. `table { line-clamp: 5 }` shows the
first 5 rows and says how many more there are.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Widgets' AS product, 1234567.891 AS revenue, 0.1834 AS margin
UNION ALL SELECT 'Gadgets', 98765.4, 0.0712
UNION ALL SELECT 'Gizmos', 4321.0, -0.021

show.title: column_list: format, align; cell[column=...] color
show.description:
`format` is a Python format for a numeric column (`{:,.2f}`, `{:.1%}`;
DataTables `render`), `align` is its text-align (numbers are right-aligned by
default); the rule `cell[column="revenue"] { color }` colors a whole column (AG
Grid `cellStyle`).

query.sql:
SELECT 'api' AS service, 12 AS errors UNION ALL SELECT 'web', 0
UNION ALL SELECT 'worker', 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'cron', 41

show.title: row_thresholds: classes on whole rows
show.description:
`row_thresholds` gives a row a class by one column's value (AG Grid `rowStyle`):
rows with 1+ errors `warning`, 10+ `danger`, which color every cell of the row.
`below: true` turns it around.

query.sql:
SELECT 'alpha' AS name, 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 'beta', NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'gamma', 3
UNION ALL SELECT 'delta', NULL

show.title: compact and striped, cell.null
show.description:
Bootstrap `.table-sm` (`cell { padding: 0 }`) and `.table-striped`
(`row:nth-child(even) { background-color }`), the header and border colors, and how
NULL looks (`cell.null { content, color, font-style }`).

query.sql: SELECT 1 AS id, 'single' AS line UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'between the rows'

show.title: table { border: heavy }, rule, caption-side
show.description:
One line style for the whole table (`table { border }`: single, rounded, heavy,
double, dashed, ascii, none; the default `rich` mixes a heavy header with a light
body), lines between the rows (`rule { display: block }`), and the title under the
table (`panel-title { caption-side: bottom }`).

query.sql:
SELECT 'Long text wraps inside its column; a word longer than the column is cut.' AS note,
       'first line' || char(10) || 'second line' AS lines

show.title: wrapping; cell { width, height }, column height
show.description:
Long cells wrap at spaces (`cell { word-break: break-all }` breaks anywhere,
`white-space: nowrap` keeps one line cut with "…"), newlines in a value start a new
line. `cell { width, height }` limit every column, `column_list[].width` / `height`
one column; a cell still too long ends with `text-overflow` ("…").

query.sql: SELECT 'no border' AS plain, 'no lines at all' AS columns

show.title: table { border: none }
show.description: No border: plain columns under a rule (Bootstrap `.table-borderless`).
